change: Bound caller-supplied Qwen TTS request timeouts to integer values between 1 and 60,000 milliseconds.
acceptance: Zero, negative, fractional, non-finite and greater-than-60-second timeout values fail with QWEN_TTS_CONFIG_INVALID.
The 1 ms and 60,000 ms boundaries are accepted.
Invalid timeout configuration fails before a fetch implementation can be invoked.
